name: Kobayashi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kobayashi city emblem in green, blue and red: a green stylised running figure with a blue swoosh and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kobayashi, a city in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Kobayashi city emblem — a green stylised running figure with a blue swoosh and a red disc
